title: Same Four People (working name)
bible: Four friends in bright everyday places (a moving train first; office meeting room and BBQ later). Mitch (Australian) is the Chaos One: relaxed, reckless, never worried. Ollie (English) is the Overthinker: polite, apologetic, panics about everything. Mei is the Deadpan: four words max, deflates both boys. Maya is the Quiet One: one line per episode, the reframe that leaves the viewer thinking, then a one-second hold and a loop. 20-28 s, 10-12 lines under 12 words, mid-conversation at frame 0. Who is at fault rotates; no gender is the running joke. The team writes or approves the final jokes. Planning: planning/2026-11-10-relatable-four-channel/.
